LaunchTorpedo.name: Torpedo Ted launcher shooter
summary: Shooter routine: every $50 frames, while on the screen's X/Y page and not near the left edge, spawns a Torpedo Ted
sprite ($44) at the shooter position facing Mario, plus an extended sprite arm.
Parameters: X = shooter index.

s02B464.name: Table: Torpedo Ted arm X speed

ShootBullet.name: Bullet Bill shooter
summary: Shooter routine: every $60 frames, if the shooter is on the screen and Mario is not right next to it,
finds a free sprite slot and falls into GenerateBullet.
Parameters: X = shooter index.

GenerateBullet.name: Spawn Bullet Bill from shooter
summary: Plays sound effect 9, creates a Bullet Bill sprite ($1C, status 1) just above the shooter and shows a smoke puff.
Parameters: X = shooter index, Y = new sprite slot.

ShowShooterSmoke.name: Show shooter smoke puff
summary: Starts a search of the four smoke slots for a free one (continues in FindFreeSmokeSlot).

FindFreeSmokeSlot.name: Find free smoke slot
summary: Searches $17C0+Y for an empty smoke slot and branches to SetShooterSmoke; returns if all four are used.

SetShooterSmoke.name: Set up shooter smoke and speed helpers
summary: Fills smoke slot Y at the shooter: type 1 (puff), Y = shooter Y, timer $1B, X = shooter X offset to Mario's side.
Parameters: X = shooter index, Y = smoke slot. Restores X from [$15E9].
Also holds unreferenced-looking helpers $02B51A-$02B5EB that apply fixed-point speed to position for bounce sprites, extended
sprites, another 4-slot effect table and minor extended sprites (speed * 16 into a subpixel accumulator, then the sign-extended high part).

PokeyClipIndex.name: Table: Pokey clipping index by segments

PokeyMain.name: Pokey main (long call wrapper)
summary: Runs PokeyMainRt, then counts the segments left in [$C2] and sets the clipping index [$1662].

PokeyLoopStart.name: Pokey: count segment bits
summary: Loop body: shifts the next segment bit out of A and counts it in Y.

BitNotSet.name: Pokey: set clipping index
summary: Finishes the segment count and stores PokeyClipIndex[count] to [$1662+X].

PokeySpeed.name: Tables: Pokey speed and squish offsets

PokeyMainRt.name: Pokey main routine entry
summary: Pokey sprite ($70). [$C2] = bitmask of segments (5 bits). [$1534] != 0 marks a detached flying segment.
Detached segments are drawn as one tile and fall; normal Pokeys run PokeyAlive.

PokeyAlive.name: Pokey: behaviour and drawing
summary: Erases the Pokey when no segments are left. Otherwise walks (direction re-picked every $80 frames), falls, turns at
walls, checks hits from kicked sprites, closes gaps in the segment bitmask and draws five 16x16 tiles with a wiggle.
Parameters: X = sprite index. Contains the segment collision check at $02B7AC.

RemovePokeySgmntRt.name: Remove Pokey segment
summary: Clears the segment hit and starts the squish animation.
Parameters: A = Y offset of the hitting sprite relative to the Pokey (selects the segment).

RemovePokeySegment.name: Remove Pokey segment (long wrapper)
summary: Sets the data bank and calls RemovePokeySgmntRt. Called from bank 1.

PokeyUnsetBit.name: Spawn flying Pokey segment, and tables
summary: Tables at $02B824/$02B829 (segment clear masks), then CODE_02B82E at $02B82E spawns a killed-status Pokey sprite
carrying the thrown-off segments, with half the hitter's X speed and Y speed $E0.

TorpedoTedMain.name: Torpedo Ted main (long wrapper)
summary: Sets the data bank and runs the Torpedo Ted routine at $02B88A: draw, interact, launch, fly.

TorpedoMaxSpeed.name: Table: Torpedo Ted max X speed

TorpedoAccel.name: Torpedo Ted flight movement
summary: Table of X acceleration, then the flight code: accelerates in X every 4 frames to its max speed, levels out Y speed and
spawns trail puffs every 8 frames.

TorpedoGfxRt.name: Torpedo Ted graphics
summary: Draws two 16x16 tiles side by side, facing the sprite direction; the second tile animates ($A0/$82).
Jumps to FinishOAMWrite via $02B7A7.

s02B94E.name: Table: Torpedo Ted trail X offset

s02B952.name: Spawn Torpedo Ted trail puff
summary: Finds a free smoke slot (or reuses one round-robin via [$18E9]) and creates a smoke puff $0F frames long behind the sprite,
if it is on the screen.
Parameters: X = sprite index.
